analysis.visual_description: On the board. The words "here York, angry" have a line through them, as a reminder spent. The messenger mark beside them is untouched.
On the board. Six short lines under the crossed mark. The hand is the working hand, not a fair copy. The three deposition sheets stay at the edge, unopened this hour.
On the board. The messenger reminder is still only the four words. No speech has been written under it. The pen is set down.
